notes.title: Thank you to all those who have played Tits and Shadows.
notes.content:
Thank you to all those who have played Tits and Shadows.

Before getting sentimental, I would like to share the patch notes with you:

THE FAST TRAVEL HAS DIED! Well, almost.
Previously, the golden statues allowed for quick travel between them from the beginning of the game. Now, it will be necessary to first activate all 4 statues to be able to do this. Why has this decision been made?
In this patch, when a new main or secondary character joins your group, they will automatically be adjusted to Hero's level to prevent hours of experience farming and potentially not wanting to use a character just because you have others at a higher level. But this accelerates the game too much, so I have removed fast travel until later in the game so that the player can familiarize themselves with the map, which is designed to have shortcuts in every corner. If we think about it objectively, the T&S map is a huge cross. This will also encourage interactions with Octavio to restock healing items.

The following characters have been modified to learn one skill each time they level up:

[list]
[*] Hero
[*] Bec Santus
[*] Wendy Woods
[*] Cherry Baba
[*] Lisa
[*] Gabriel
[*] Minerva Cos
[*] Vincent
[*] Victoria
[/list]

This means that their skill trees have been reduced with the intention of focusing them more on specific roles. For example, now Gabriel is more focused on healing, while Lisa is focused on inflicting status ailments on enemies. To solve the new limitation on magic abilities, books will now allow users to add 2 types of elemental magic. Also, now Vanessa will also be in the church once the library is opened, selling books!

[b]New home screen with Victoria as the star.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44198467/eb39908ea05fc3a2f9cb5a22d53eaaab660f5ffc.jpg[/img]

Thank you all!
I take this opportunity to thank all those who buy and play Tits and Shadows. Although it is still far from what I want, it warms my heart to see people dedicating time to side quests, hunting achievements, and finding secrets that I scattered throughout the map. Many things have happened in this time and many things have changed since T&S saw the light on Steam. I hope to continue creating an experience that you can enjoy as something enjoyable and entertaining. To thank you for all this time that has been allowed to me to work on this video game, I want to give you 4 wallpapers.

notes.title: Tits and Shadows: A Content-Packed Update!
notes.content:
Tits and Shadows: A Content-Packed Update!

Greetings, esteemed players!

I'm excited to present to you a content-packed update for Tits and Shadows. This update brings so many new features that I honestly can't remember everything I've added!

Firstly, I've updated the dialogues in Cherry and Lisa's introduction. Additionally, in future updates, I'll expand and enhance Lisa's story to provide an even more immersive experience.

But that's not all! I've also added powerful new armors that will be available in the final segments of the game. You'll be able to obtain them in the church or in Mamy's bandit base, so make sure to explore thoroughly to find them.

And to breathe more life into the game world, I've introduced new NPC characters in Putana Castle. These characters are designed to enrich this area of the game and provide more opportunities for interaction.

I hope you enjoy these new additions as much as I enjoyed creating them. Thank you for your continued support, and I hope you continue to enjoy Tits and Shadows!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44198467/c0853c2bef742e88989c7fafd7b784f4d321227c.png[/img]

notes.title: Tits and Shadows: Enhanced Combat Update
notes.content:
Tits and Shadows: Enhanced Combat Update

This update is crucial! I'm pleased to share that we've made significant changes to the entire turn-based combat system. Now, to use powerful abilities, it's necessary to channel them, which will require a full turn. Both players and enemies will be subject to this limitation.

Abilities like Swiftness, Delay, and Interruption now function within our Active Time Battle (ATB) combat system. For existing players, if your character has reached level 10, you'll be able to learn the "Channel" ability, which will grant you access to this enhancement. However, if you haven't reached level 10 yet, don't worry and continue your journey. For new players, the ability will be learned automatically.

What does this mean for those playing using ATB? Honestly, the future of ATB isn't very promising. It seems that most players don't enjoy this mode of play, so it will be removed in upcoming updates. Please switch your play style to classic while you still have the chance.

Altered States:

We've also made updates to altered states, significantly reducing their quantity. Now, unstable states prohibit channeling, and states that limit the player's actions are more likely to be removed when the player takes damage.

This is a significant update. While I haven't been able to update all weapon descriptions and names yet, my priority is to ensure that combat functions as it should. Please report any errors with the functioning of this patch.

notes.title: Small Update: Closed Doors
notes.content:
Small Update: Closed Doors

This update has been released unexpectedly to fix previous errors that were causing issues with mining in an underground area. This includes an additional update that was scheduled for next week, in which the switches of many doors have been changed and their operation to improve performance a bit more.

Some doors in caves and in the swamp will be closed again. I have ensured that none of these blocks the player's progress or leaves them in an infinite loop when loading the game, but if you find any error that prevents you from progressing, please let me know.

Sincerely,
Luis from LuQui

notes.title: Tits and Shadows: Stores and More Update
notes.content:
Tits and Shadows: Stores and More Update

Greetings, dear players! We are pleased to present to you the latest update, primarily focused on improvements to the stores. We now have specialized vendors offering a unique variety of goods.

Store Changes:
For instance, Catherine now specializes in selling a wide range of plants and mushroom jelly. Meanwhile, in the Slime Cave, you will find everything related to minerals. We invite you to explore the stores to discover the exciting new offerings.

New EXP Potion:
Introducing the EXP Potion, a valuable elixir that allows your DLC allies or others to quickly reach the maximum level. Although it is an expensive item, you can also craft it with the help of our dear Darky. The recipe will unlock upon defeating Putana.

Enemy Pursuit Enhancements:
We have significantly reduced the time it takes for enemies to initiate pursuits, so now you must exercise caution when passing near their line of sight. The excitement and challenge have been intensified.

Increased Quartz Ore Drops:
We acknowledge the importance of quartz, and we understand that previous ore yields were insufficient. We have considerably increased the amount of quartz obtained from mining, making the experience much more rewarding.

New Enemy: Bloodsucker:
In the mysterious swamp cave, a new challenge has been added: the Bloodsucker. This resilient creature has a sole purpose to disable members of your team. It is recommended to stun or eliminate it quickly.

New NPCs in Putan Castle:
With the arrival at Putan Castle, we have introduced new inhabitants. The werewolf brothers Athos, Portos, and Ariamis are the first NPCs to establish themselves in the castle.

We hope you enjoy these exciting updates and continue your adventure in Tits and Shadows!

notes.title: Tits and Shadows Update: Wild Beasts
notes.content:
Tits and Shadows Update: Wild Beasts

Greetings, dear players! This update was a creative challenge. With improvements in armor and a reduction in enemies, the game became too easy. Battles with creatures like wolves, bats, eagles, and jaguars became annoyingly simple. To completely change the dynamics of facing these enemies, the game's beasts have shifted their approach to battle.

Now, these creatures specialize in inducing status effects in the player's group. Dealing with them, whether stunning or silencing, might be your best option. Furthermore, the effects of player's stun and other altered states abilities have been changed. Now, the most powerful version of these skills will be an area-of-effect attack capable of causing altered states to the entire enemy team. Prepare to face the Wild Beasts and discover new strategies to survive!

notes.title: Balance Update in Tits and Shadows:
notes.content:
Balance Update in Tits and Shadows:

Greetings to all passionate players, I'm Luis from LuQui, back with exciting news!

I am pleased to inform you that, after immersing myself once again in Tits and Shadows with the recent combat modifications, I have managed to fix an error that could make the battle between Cherry and the Primordial Slime potentially endless. This means that the gaming experience will be much smoother and more thrilling!

Additionally, Cherry now has the opportunity to learn the "Regeneration Block" skill, significantly reducing the duration of this battle, providing a more balanced challenge.

In this update, we have enriched Minerva's skill set and adjusted the mana costs of magical skills to enhance gameplay and strategy on the battlefield.

Finally, we have optimized the general armor set, allowing the inclusion of up to 4 pieces. This improvement gives Cherry the chance to reap greater benefits from general armors, adding more depth and tactical options to the game.

We hope you enjoy these enhancements and continue to relish your experience in Tits and Shadows! Get ready for new thrills and challenges on your journey through this fascinating world!

notes.title: Tits and Shadows Update : Armors and Enemies.
notes.content:
Greetings, Tits and Shadows community! Luis is back to share the latest updates with you. I apologize for the shortage of updates this month, but I have exciting news: I am getting ready to showcase Tits and Shadows at an adult exhibition in my country.

Although this update may be smaller in size, its impact is significant. It primarily focuses on armor improvements. Here are the key changes:

Heavy Armor:

Magical resistance of Heavy Armor has been significantly improved.
It now grants a greater amount of life to the user, providing a stronger defense on the battlefield.
General Armor:

This armor now increases the experience (EXP) gained by its users.
A beneficial addition for those looking to level up their alternative characters that have fallen behind.
Enemy AI Enhancement:

The skills of many enemies have been adjusted to strategically target characters on your team with higher life.
This change aims to prevent all enemies from focusing solely on those with better physical or magical defense, providing a more equitable approach in battles.

I appreciate your patience and ongoing support as we work to enhance the Tits and Shadows experience. May these changes make battles feel more challenging and fair! Get ready for the next adventure in the world of Tits and Shadows!

notes.title: Tits and Shadows - Minor Immersion Update
notes.content:
Tits and Shadows - Minor Immersion Update

Dear players, welcome back! We're excited to share the details of our latest update, focused on enhancing immersion in the world of Tits and Shadows.

New Faces:
We've welcomed two new characters that will enrich your gaming experience. Get ready to meet fascinating additions that bring intriguing stories and exciting challenges.

Protecting Your Steps:
We introduce Boots, an essential addition to your equipment. Designed to counter adverse effects, these boots are your salvation against conditions like freezing. But this is just the beginning! We plan to expand the variety of boots to provide protection against other altered states, such as stun and pause, in future updates.

Eventful Confrontations:
The battle against the ice specter now features predetermined events, adding narrative layers and strategic challenges to this thrilling encounter. Are you ready to face this specter and uncover the secrets it holds?

We appreciate your ongoing support and hope you enjoy these new additions on your journey through the world of Tits and Shadows. Until the next update!

Sincerely,
Luis from LuQui

notes.content:
Tits and Shadows - Update: The Renegades

notes.title: Unexpected update
notes.content:
A delightful surprise awaits you today as we unveil an unexpected update. This release not only addresses a pesky bug that had been impeding the smooth flow of the game during standard attacks but also introduces two fantastic new weapons into the mix.

Our newest addition, the "Morningstar," is more than just an item; it's a token of our appreciation for the vibrant Discord community that enriches our gaming world. To claim this striking weapon, simply head to the trophy room and enter the exclusive code Found in the Discord server. The Morningstar is a symbol of unity and a testament to your support, and we can't wait for you to wield it.

Now, for those dedicated players who took the time to report bugs and help us refine our gaming experience, we have a special treat—the "Rapier." This elegant weapon is reserved for the diligent souls who made the game better by sharing their valuable feedback. If you fall into this esteemed group, please send me a direct message, and we'll ensure the Rapier finds its way into your capable hands.

We thank you for being an integral part of our gaming journey and look forward to sharing this new chapter with you. Happy gaming!

notes.title: Tits and Shadows Update: Path to Halloween
notes.content:
Tits and Shadows Update: Path to Halloween

Greetings, dear players! In this update, we have incorporated exciting features that will enhance your gaming experience:

1. **New Characters and Dialogues**: We have updated four NPCs with unique names and dialogues, including one with a secret mission! This brings us closer to our goal of making every background character truly unique.

2. **Expanded Dialogues**: Additional dialogues have been added for Mamy Evergreen, L Kaiser, and Andromeda. Now, it's less likely that you'll hear the same dialogue twice in a row unless it's related to a mission.

3. **Error Corrections**: We've fixed minor translation errors and a significant issue that caused the game to crash when bandits used the multiple attack ability.

4. **Gems Transformed into Accessories**: Gems created with the jeweler are now accessories. Simply having them in your inventory will grant you benefits! However, these bonuses won't stack with other gems of the same name.

We are thrilled to announce that the universe of Tits and Shadows is gearing up for one of our favorite holidays: Halloween. To celebrate, we've included two new character appearances:

- **Painlord Hero**: Inspired largely by Clive Barker's creations in Hellraiser, this appearance will immerse you in darkness and mystery.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44198467/e97aa177cb40e564c6906120e1ccf7c435ee4710.png[/img]

- **Fallen Angel Gabriel**: What's a Halloween party without a touch of the diabolical? Gabriel dons this appearance, giving you a glimpse of what they would look like if they decided to change their path in life.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44198467/f493b6cd96c43a9762cf30348e0b444d1819d2aa.png[/img]

We hope you enjoy these additions as we embark together on the exciting path to Halloween in Tits and Shadows!

notes.title: Tits and Shadows: Immersion Update
notes.content:
Tits and Shadows: Immersion Update

In this exciting update for Tits and Shadows, we are pleased to announce a series of enhancements and additions that will make your gaming experience even more immersive and captivating.

Enriched Dialogues: We have expanded the dialogues of our main characters, providing you with a deeper connection to the plot and protagonists, including the beloved Bruno and Iris.

A Glimpse into the Future: This update is just a step forward in our vision for a Tits and Shadows world where each NPC will have their own unique design and dialogues. We continue to work on it and are excited about what's to come.

Interactive Furniture: Objects within houses now come to life more dynamically. Some hold useful items for adventurers, while others offer a unique auditory experience when interacted with. Explore every corner and discover the secrets they hold!

The Mysterious Labyrinth: A labyrinth filled with challenges and surprises has arisen between the Enchanted Forest and the Faun's Lair. Do you have the courage and wit to overcome it?

The Frog King and His New Mission: The Frog King has a special mission for you, and the reward promises to be intriguing. Dive into this adventure and discover the treasures that await in his realm.

We are thrilled to share these updates with you and to continue expanding the universe of Tits and Shadows. We hope this update immerses you even further into a world full of possibilities and adventures. Get ready to explore and enjoy a game that goes beyond simple interconnected environments!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44198467/a593fd1b7ec781ac7905f9968e7db161ce541363.png[/img]

notes.title: "Tits and Shadows: Weekly Update"
notes.content:
"Tits and Shadows: Weekly Update"

This update brings a host of exciting improvements that you're sure to enjoy!

- We've conducted a rebalance of weapons and enemies to ensure a more satisfying gaming experience.

- To make the Tower of Challenge possible, we've adjusted encounter durations, speeding up the action.

- As a new addition, we've introduced a new type of weapon: pistols. This will expand your equipment options and combat tactics.

- Gloves are now considered a universal type of armor, meaning all characters can benefit from their use.

The Tower of Challenge

Face 11 random battles that will test your skills, and as a reward, you'll receive a super-powerful weapon that will turn you into a true champion.

New Skin: Wendy La Llorona

To celebrate Mexican Independence Day, we've created a new skin for one of the game's most beloved characters. It's the perfect opportunity to freshen up your gaming experience!

Potion Price Reduction

In order to maintain a fair economic balance, we've reduced potion prices. Now you can take care of your health without worrying about your wallet.

Additionally, we've made various minor bug fixes to ensure you get the most out of your adventure. Keep playing and exploring the exciting world of Tits and Shadows!

notes.title: Tits and Shadows: Victoria - New Update!
notes.content:
Tits and Shadows: Victoria - New Update!

[previewyoutube=dypAbMdrW4g;full][/previewyoutube]

With this latest update, we delve into the past to explore new dimensions. Here are the additions we've incorporated since Tits and Shadows first saw the light on Steam!

Gameplay Enhancements:

Running:
At the start of our adventure, running wasn't an option, but that has changed. Now you can move swiftly across the map. Additionally, we're working on puzzles that will require alternating between running and walking, adding an extra layer of strategy.

Aerial Balloon:
We've introduced an aerial balloon to streamline travel between different zones. This also serves as a reward upon completing the main story, providing a smoother experience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44198467/be861dd3f05e652abf46bb83a80fe2d1afdc7452.gif[/img]

Additional Characters:
Vincent, a demonic mage with the highest magical power, and L. Kaiser, a passionate cartographer, join our ranks. Additionally, the brave Victoria Barajas becomes part of our team.

Balance and Challenge:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44198467/1b69ed85742a9a74d6527b2e7f8091b2acb01fbe.jpg[/img]

Enemy Balance and Hero Mode:
We've adjusted the game's difficulty for a more balanced experience. However, for those seeking an even greater challenge, we've added the Hero mode.

Two Combat Systems: Classic and Active Time Battle (ATB)

Classic System:
We've incorporated the beloved classic combat system for players yearning for the nostalgia of traditional games like the iconic Final Fantasy series. In this system, you can enjoy turn-based strategy and carefully calculate each move, adding an authentic touch to your gaming experience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44198467/92dc96bc4faf2189bd0c1134d11586a00b43dcaf.gif[/img]

ATB System:
The Active Time Battle (ATB) system offers a dynamic and thrilling combat experience. Instead of waiting for your turn, you'll be immersed in real-time action. You'll need to make quick and precise decisions while controlling your characters in the midst of battle. This innovative mechanic heightens excitement and urgency in each fight, providing a deeper sense of connection with the confrontation.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44198467/314ad0e7096037e69b82654a3aa8d5f4d7a909df.gif[/img]

NPCs and Quests:

NPC Development: With each update, we work on incorporating NPCs with unique designs, some offering side quests that, while simple, delve into their personality and the overall plot.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44198467/e387d9e00c0cf639810c05306d6e8b6f55384b20.gif[/img]

New Locations:
The Sky City and the Catacombs of Beings: These two areas expand the story of Kiwi Village, adding intriguing layers to the narrative. While we still have many ideas in mind, we're excited about the accomplished design.
From now on, our updates will have names reflecting their contents and focuses.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44198467/992b9ad9680a374f0bbb6f62c391562074723c84.png[/img]

I want to take this opportunity to thank you for your continued support, for investing your time in our game, and for accompanying us at every stage of this journey.

Sincerely,
Luis from LuQui

notes.title: Tits and Shadows - SFW Patch
notes.content:
The SFW DLC transforms all the sensual images and sounds in the game into sleek black screens and serene silence. 
This addition is primarily designed for individuals who intend to create content for social media or platforms, streamlining the editing process significantly.

To remove this DLC and return to the original Tits and Shadows experience, right-click the game in your Steam library and choose "Properties." Next, navigate to the DLC section and unselect the SFW DLC. Close the window, and Steam should automatically uninstall this DLC from your computer.

notes.title: 'Tits and Shadows' Update v1.22
notes.content:
'Tits and Shadows' Update v1.22: What's New in This Update

In this version, we are pleased to introduce a range of enhancements that will make your gaming experience even more enjoyable and challenging. What's new in this update?

Presentation Enhancement: Autowrap in Dialogues

We've heard your feedback and implemented Autowrap, a feature that prevents text from overflowing out of dialogue boxes during conversations. This addresses an annoying issue where character dialogues were cut off and difficult to follow. Now, you can enjoy uninterrupted conversations without visual interruptions.

Hero Mode Combat Balance

We've invested time and effort into refining and balancing the Hero Mode, which offers a challenging combat experience, sometimes even demanding. We want to ensure that your encounters with enemies are exciting and rewarding, yet not unfair. We've thoroughly tested each battle in this mode and made adjustments to achieve optimal balance. Hero Mode is particularly recommended for players who have completed the game in normal mode at least once.

Enhanced World Drops: A World of Rewards

We've taken your suggestions into account and amplified the excitement of exploring every corner of the 'Tits and Shadows' world. Now, when you discover hidden chests and treasures, the rewards will be even more thrilling. We've improved the quality of weapons and armor you can uncover, making each chest a significant incentive for delving deep into exploration.

General Programming Improvement: Efficiency and Optimization

Your experience's quality is our priority, so we've worked on enhancing the game's general programming. We've identified processes that unnecessarily consumed resources during gameplay and opted for alternative solutions that yield the same results. This not only contributes to smoother performance but also ensures that you can enjoy 'Tits and Shadows' optimally.

Map Enhancement: A World in Constant Evolution

We've heard your feedback regarding navigation in certain outdoor maps and have decided to give them a special touch. Some maps have been updated and enhanced to work more smoothly with the enemy pursuit system. We want your gameplay experience to be as immersive and engaging as possible, and these adjustments contribute to achieving that.

Complete Base Experience: Proud of Our Achievements

With these improvements and adjustments, we're excited to announce that the core experience of 'Tits and Shadows' has reached an exceptional level. While we continue to plan for more exciting content and features in the future, we're immensely proud of what we've accomplished so far. We hope you immerse yourself in this world of epic fantasy and enjoy every aspect of the adventure we've crafted for you.

We appreciate your ongoing support and valuable feedback, which inspire us to continue making 'Tits and Shadows' an unforgettable experience. Get ready to keep exploring, battling, and discovering in this evolving and exciting journey!

notes.title: [Tits and Shadows - Update v 1.16
notes.content:
[b]Tits and Shadows - Update v 1.16[/b]

Greetings, brave adventurers of Tits and Shadows! We hope you are enjoying this thrilling journey through our incredible fantasy world!

But before we delve into this new update, we want to applaud cyn115 for their impressive speedrun! A time of 1:27:39 is simply amazing! Thank you for participating and being part of this unique community!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44198467/5e6aa3846d9319dcdabcf7fa0638a45b568b67f7.jpg[/img]

The challenge continues, and we can't wait to see your best times in this exciting Speedrun Challenge! Don't give up and showcase your skills in this incredible competition! Go for it, brave souls!

[b]Now, let's dive into the exciting update we have prepared for you![/b]

- Enemies have improved AI and now have a detection radius. They will pursue you, so get ready to face new challenges! Some encounters can be strategically avoided by escaping or using areas with high grass to your advantage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44198467/611895fc16fa399d381447846e20a2574b5aacb1.png[/img]

It's time to be smarter and use nature to your advantage! We are also working on adapting maps to make "hide and seek" dynamics more thrilling and challenging.

- We have completely revamped the combat interface! We hope it's more aesthetic and allows you to have a clearer view of the battlefield. Let every battle be epic!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44198467/c8b406714c0f4f3bf88ecb89ea5fbdc23a3a0908.jpg[/img]

- Oh, and something important: enemies now scale their level with the player! So, don't let your guard down even if you reach the maximum level! Low-level encounters will still be a threat and keep you alert.

- Additionally, we have added animations to status effects! We want to provide a more immersive gaming experience, and these animations will help you remember if you are affected by any negative status.

- As we explored the depths of the code, we found an error with enemies that have double turns, so we have temporarily removed them. But don't worry, we are working to bring them back soon, and maybe with some additional surprises.

- We have also organized skills into categories to make the menu easier to navigate. We don't want you to miss any powerful spells or abilities!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44198467/565f7761e9227b75033dba0d87f6459c28583543.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44198467/5109e4afb4d2cfc679f3a055e9d37388392341dd.jpg[/img]

But beware! If you are already immersed in the adventure and notice that you don't have access to any skills, remember to deactivate the god mode, even if it's not activated, so your characters return to their base stats, and the skills become available again. We don't want you to be powerless!

Oh, and we have exciting plans for the future! We are working on implementing a "Skill Shop," where you can expand the magical and skill catalog of your characters. More options, more power, more fun!

- And that's not all! We have added new skills and status effects for some enemies. Get ready to face new challenges and strategies.

- Moreover, enemies now have a higher chance of dropping usable items upon defeat. So be sure to check the treasures they leave behind!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44198467/1b69ed85742a9a74d6527b2e7f8091b2acb01fbe.jpg[/img]

Now, when facing enemies, you'll know their weaknesses. That's right! If you attack them with an element they are weak against, they'll let you know. But that's not all; the information will be recorded below their name, so you won't forget!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44198467/a9b88d768f7dc60bcb1e8557611aec05c1ca1e5f.jpg[/img]

Do you want to have the upper hand in battles? No problem! We've added the "Revealing Lens," a magical tool that will show you the enemies' weaknesses without the need to guess. A true ace up your sleeve!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44198467/730c0d972eaf8f13845a2d4684c3560a748833cf.jpg[/img]

- Of course, in the process of improvements, we have also fixed some pesky bugs. We've resolved the bug that prevented you from leaving the right side of the pyramid in the Mictlán update, and we've adjusted some collisions in the frozen mountain. We've also properly aligned the English text. And, oh, we've removed a skill with a code name that definitely shouldn't have been in Hero's repertoire!

Finally, there's a small inconvenience that we are still investigating. When loading an old save file in the first few seconds of the game, the cemetery map is displayed. We are working hard to find a definitive solution!

As always, we deeply appreciate your support and feedback. We are open to complaints, suggestions, and bug reports. Our mission is to make Tits and Shadows an unforgettable gaming experience for all of you.

We wish you an excellent week full of adventures and excitement in our incredible fantasy world!

ATT - Luis de LuQui

notes.title: Tits and shadows V1.1 Active Time Battle System
notes.content:
I am pleased to announce to all our players that we have made significant changes to the battle system of Tits and Shadows V1.1: Active Time Battle! Although it is still menu-based, the player will now be more immersed and attentive to each of their actions.

The Active Time Battle system rewards critical thinking and exploiting the enemy's weaknesses.

To incorporate this new update into your game, please follow these steps:

[list]
[*] Talk to Erinn in the trophy room.
[*] Request to reset all your characters with the new abilities, even if you don't have God mode activated.
[*] Additionally, to not spoil anyone's experience, you are allowed to take an experience boost that will raise the level of all your characters to the maximum when resetting their stats.
[/list]


New players do not need to perform any of the above actions as the new system is enabled by default.

We have placed a Skullie in the trophy room so you can watch the tutorial if necessary and address any questions. Enjoy the exciting Active Time Battle in Tits and Shadows V1.1!

We appreciate your feedback and would like to remind you that we are still working on making necessary balance adjustments in the game. We greatly value your opinions and suggestions as they help us improve the experience for all players.

Additionally, you can adjust the combat system speed in the Options menu to suit your gameplay style. Personally, I have it set to speed 1.

Please feel free to share any additional comments you may have. Your feedback is important to us, and we are committed to making this game an exciting and balanced experience for everyone. Thank you for your support and collaboration!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44198467/25d13823e0e16b44d470cce3851729445efd1575.png[/img]


A new patch has been added that allows the player to choose between the new combat system or the classic one. This can be done when starting a game or by talking to Erinn in the trophy house.

I am working diligently to ensure that both combat systems are balanced.

-Luis from LuQui

notes.title: Update 1.01 - Andromeda
notes.content:
[b]Update 1.01 - Andromeda[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44198467/22e8e38f3bcf1bdaa953fb11c028c4284cf1afc3.png[/img]

We are pleased to present the first Steam update, version 1.01. Here's a brief summary of the introduced features, but not limited to:

New Story:
Strange creatures have emerged from the caves and are planning to destroy everything! It's your task to put an end to their expedition. In this update, we have added a new area with 2 completely new enemies and new accessories that expand the possibilities for your favorite characters. We have also introduced a new character, Andromeda. We can't wait for you to meet her!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44198467/4064e4a3b22cb521a566602531f84eb204abeef2.png[/img]

[b]Special Guest:[/b]
We are also excited to announce our collaboration with the Spanish game review channel, Frames Laveth. We are immensely grateful for their participation in Tits and Shadows. You can find more information on the YouTube channel "[url=https://www.youtube.com/@elframeshablandoweas3864]El Frames hablando weas[/url]."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44198467/cd4c55ac7b071f56062561b78d6d148d834b2300.png[/img]

[b]Combat Balance:[/b]
In this update, we have made significant changes to accessories and their interaction with players. The accessories sold by Iris, the blacksmith, now enhance all player attributes, while Nick's artisan stones provide more specific improvements. We have also created new accessories that can completely turn the tide of battle in favor of the player. Additionally, some characters now have a higher chance of inflicting status ailments on enemies. We hope this combat update makes the game more enjoyable and balanced for all of you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44198467/5090304710b4c71489691337c35077b408744bcb.png[/img]

[b]The Air Balloon:[/b]
In Tits and Shadows, we strive to design levels with as few "dead" areas as possible. However, we acknowledge that some parts of the game can become tedious to traverse. To address this, we have decided to introduce the Air Balloon as a new means of transportation. It will be available only to those who have defeated Putana and wish to complete side or optional quests. We believe this addition will be incredibly fun.

Important Note: For players using save data from before this update, we have identified an issue where the balloon overlaps with the environment. Although it can be annoying, we haven't found a solution for this problem yet.

[b]Micro Missions:[/b]
From now on, some NPCs and citizens will offer small additional quests that will not be recorded in the mission journal. These missions have been created to give a purpose to the surplus resources that some players may accumulate and, in return, provide experience points.

[b]Extended Gallery:[/b]
We have expanded the gallery to also include the sexy images that players encounter during the game.
[u]Note: Some players may experience a strange corruption in the number of unlocked images.[/u]
[u]We are working on a solution to compensate for this issue.[/u]

[b]Bug Fixes and Crashes:[/b]
[list]
[*] We have fixed some errors in the text displaying the code used for translation. We have also resolved an issue where Lisa's image would remain on the screen

 during one of her sexy scenes.
[*] Additionally, we have fixed a bug that prevented opening a chest in the "Forgotten Wasteland."
[/list]

We hope you enjoy this update and we appreciate your continued support.
Have fun playing!
